title: Complete pink using small railroad sweetener
description: Complete pink using small railroad sweetener. Pink is developable and the offer is small enough not to overpay. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Gamma, interested in a quick deal? I’ll give you the Reading Railroad plus $100 for your Virginia Avenue. Let me know!
final_action.private_thought: Need pink monopoly. Offering Reading Railroad + $100 for Virginia. Should be fair; Gamma gets cash and a railroad. Improves my rent potential.
